<p dir="auto"><strong>PointNeighbors.jl</strong> is a package for neighborhood search with fixed search radius in
1D, 2D and 3D point clouds.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 class="heading-element" dir="auto">Features</h2><a id="user-content-features" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Features" href="#features"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Several implementations of neighborhood search with fixed search radius</li>
<li>Focus on fast incremental updates to be usable for particle-based simulations with
frequent updates</li>
<li>Designed as a "playground" to easily switch between different implementations and data
structures</li>
<li>Common API over all implementations</li>
<li>Extensive benchmark suite to study different implementations (work in progress)</li>
<li>GPU compatibility (work in progress)</li>
</ul>
<markdown-accessiblity-table><table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Implementation</th>
<th>Description</th>
<th>Features</th>
<th align="center">Query</th>
<th align="center">Update</th>
<th align="center">GPU-compatible</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><code>GridNeighborhoodSearch</code> with <code>DictionaryCellList</code></td>
<td>Grid-based NHS with Julia <code>Dict</code> backend</td>
<td>Infinite domain</td>
<td align="center">Fast</td>
<td align="center">Fast</td>
<td align="center">❌</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>GridNeighborhoodSearch</code> with <code>FullGridCellList</code></td>
<td>Grid-based NHS allocating all cells of the domain</td>
<td>Finite domain, but efficient memory layout for densely filled domain.</td>
<td align="center">Faster</td>
<td align="center">Fastest</td>
<td align="center">✅</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>PrecomputedNeighborhoodSearch</code></td>
<td>Precompute neighbor lists</td>
<td>Best for <a href="https://trixi-framework.github.io/TrixiParticles.jl/stable/systems/total_lagrangian_sph/" rel="nofollow">TLSPH</a> without NHS updates. Not suitable for updates in every time step.</td>
<td align="center">Fastest</td>
<td align="center">Very slow</td>
<td align="center">❌</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table></markdown-accessiblity-table>

<p dir="auto">The following benchmarks were conducted on an AMD Ryzen Threadripper 3990X using 128 threads.</p>
<p dir="auto">Benchmark of a single force computation step of a Weakly Compressible SPH (WCSPH) simulation:
<a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" href="https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/44124897/347151123-ad5c378b-9ce2-4e6f-91dc-1e0da379b91f.png?jwt=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.._jBg7utQKylI0OSkgp6y6Hpq5JaC5aISN98g92VIAE4"><img src="https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/44124897/347151123-ad5c378b-9ce2-4e6f-91dc-1e0da379b91f.png?jwt=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.._jBg7utQKylI0OSkgp6y6Hpq5JaC5aISN98g92VIAE4" alt="wcsph" style="max-width: 100%;"></a></p>
<p dir="auto">Benchmark of an incremental update similar to a WCSPH simulation (note the log scale):
